script_text: Virgo, Mercury squares Mars in Aries this week, igniting your 1st House of Self with restless Earth-element tension. Early week, communication friction peaks on Monday and Tuesday. Avoid signing contracts Tuesday when the Moon squares your 10th House of Career, risking workplace clashes. Wednesday is your midweek turning point: Venus enters your 7th House of Partnerships, pulling someone from your past back for a love reconnection with emotional depth. Late week shifts as Jupiter trines your 2nd House of Money on Friday, unlocking a financial opportunity tied to your expertise. The weekend carries a quiet, reflective energy perfect for reviewing goals. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, activating deep romantic connection. Saturday is your worst day as Mercury slows into shadow, clouding your 6th House of Daily Work. Trust your instincts on financial decisions and hold firm on career boundaries. Follow for daily updates.
